breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction to ignore the effective length factor (K) in the Euler load calculation, despite providing the correct formula later. The ground truth resolves this by removing the contradictory instruction. The generated specification also successfully resolves this by omitting the incorrect statement and only including the correct formula: P_cr = π² × E × I / (K × L)².
